variables.name: INTERLEAVE2_TABLE
variables.comment:
* This expands 8 bit indices into 16 bit contents (high bit 14), by inserting 0s between bits.
     * In a binary field, this operation is the same as squaring an 8 bit number.
     * 
     * NOTE: All entries are positive so sign-extension is not an issue.

variables.name: INTERLEAVE3_TABLE
variables.comment: * This expands 7 bit indices into 21 bit contents (high bit 18), by inserting 0s between bits.

variables.name: INTERLEAVE4_TABLE
variables.comment: * This expands 8 bit indices into 32 bit contents (high bit 28), by inserting 0s between bits.

variables.name: INTERLEAVE5_TABLE
variables.comment: * This expands 7 bit indices into 35 bit contents (high bit 30), by inserting 0s between bits.

variables.name: INTERLEAVE7_TABLE
variables.comment: * This expands 9 bit indices into 63 bit (long) contents (high bit 56), by inserting 0s between bits.
